idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18). I rolled production back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback status: v2.3.0 in all three regions, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was healthy in staging only and was not used because it has no production health record. Follow-up needed: investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened a SEV2 incident, INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release marked healthy in production. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy release. v2.3.1-rc was healthy only in staging, so I did not use it.
- **Current state:** All three regions are on v2.3.0. The service reports healthy, with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18 on v2.3.1.
- **Approval:** No change-manager approval was needed, because v2.3.0 has a healthy production record.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback, the post-rollback state, and the need to investigate v2.3.1 before it is released again.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy one, and v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
